Name: More Bundles
Author: spacemonkeyy86
Description:
This mod adds a new difficulty setting for the community center. This setting makes each item in the community center a challenge to obtain, which makes completing it a more active and difficult task.

Every bundle has been dramatically changed, usually by:
- Requiring more items to complete
- Requiring higher quality items
- Requiring more types of items

I tried not to increase the demands to a point where it is simply annoying to get all the items. Instead, I tried to make the bundles require hard-to-obtain items so the player feels like they've achieved something every time they deposit one.

This mod is not a Content Patcher mod - in addition to adding the new bundle data, it adds a new menu option for the community center bundles and applies a fix to prevent some of the bundles from breaking.

I have also provided the [url=https://github.com/TwinBuilderOne/StardewValleyMods]source code[/url]﻿.
